candidate_evidence.quote: The main purpose of this study was to evaluate the efficacy and safety of fluzoparil combined with temozolomide in patients with recurrent glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Registered name 'fluzoparil' (also 'fluzoparide' in exclusions); INN fluzoparib used as active moiety. Temozolomide given in the only arm as rechallenge backbone in recurrent disease; coded soc_backbone (every arm receives it; question is fluzoparib).
